title: Ended up with a year subscription
body: I canceled the free trial but somehow ended up with a year subscription, wich i found pretty pricey.. the app itself seems like a lot of reminders in an already overstimulated life…
author: Alane86

title: No reminder notification before end of free trial
body:
I cannot give a review about the application itself since I have not used it. 
But I have had a very unfortunate experience.
One of the main reasons I went through with a free trial was because they said there would be a reminder 2days prior to billing. With our type of affliction, you know, we’re impulsive and forgetful I needed this reassurance so as not to be worried about billing going through. I could simply cancel when the reminder would come up.
However it did not. No email, no notification.
Long story short, I’ve been in contact with Apple and the contact for this application to get a refund. It was very confusing and stressful and either one was blaming the other about blocking the refund.

There is either a fault in the app about the end of free trial notifications or they are simply dishonest. After my email exchanges I am honestly not sure what to think but I shall not be doing this again.

Reminder that EU law states that a purchase can be cancelled within 14 days. It also states that if the seller (in this case Apple) doesn’t mention this during the purchase, the 14 days can be extended to a year.
author: Elyedi
